assumptions.statement: The team is using Terraform to manage AWS security groups, specifically the `aws_security_group_rule` resource.
There is an existing set of security group rules with names that do not currently comply with the chosen standard.
assumptions.quote: change all the existing rule names to comply with it

assumptions.statement: The security rules primarily use TCP protocol, as non-TCP protocols are treated as an edge case requiring an additional suffix.
assumptions.quote: If the rule uses a protocol other than TCP we will add an additional `_$proto` to the end.
